mapper.select: select id, question_type type, content text, sort_no sort from standard_question where is_deleted = 0 order by id
select id, question_type type, content text, sort_no sort from standard_question where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select id, option_content content, sort_no sort from standard_question_option where standard_question_id = #{standardQuestionId} order by sort_no
mapper.insert: insert into standard_question (question_type, content, is_required, sort_no, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) values (#{type}, #{text}, 0, #{sort}, 0, now(), now())
insert into standard_question_option (standard_question_id, option_content, sort_no, create_time) values (#{standardQuestionId}, #{content}, #{sortNo}, now())
mapper.update: update standard_question set question_type = #{type}, content = #{text}, sort_no = #{sort}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
update standard_question set is_deleted = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
